calculation_steps: PSD D implies ||X||_2<=sqrt(d_L d_H) by Schur complement, including zero-damping limit.
gamma=a_L d_L+a_H d_H+tr(B_L X B_H^T); |cross|<=2 sqrt(a_L a_H d_L d_H) using Frobenius Cauchy-Schwarz.
Compatible extremizer B_i=sqrt(a_i) I2 and X=rho sqrt(d_L d_H)I2 has twofold D eigenvalues with nonnegative values for |rho|<=1.
Convert d_i to 2 pi m_eff Delta_f_i in high-Q limit and replay archived pair weights for cutoffs 14,16,18 Angstrom.
Admissible rho(P)=sin(k(P-P0)) yields arbitrary local derivative with fixed diagonal widths; therefore pointwise drag envelopes do not fix load slope.

counterexamples_and_failures: rho=-1,0,+1 give same diagonal pair loss but different scalar drag in a compatible passive map.
rho(P)=sin(k(P-P0)) has fixed pair loss and arbitrary cross-loss pressure derivative; no local drag pressure slope follows from the widths alone.
